dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: I never thought that Ritou would play host to a festival by the Yae Publishing House, nor that this many people would show up.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Thanks to the Irodori Festival, our Inazuman products and toys have been very popular indeed, even those that aren't necessarily part of our event-specific promotions.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Wow. The Irodori Festival hasn't started yet, and there are already so many people on Ritou...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Well, dear customer, you'll have to wait till the festival starts to get one of our Statues of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder!

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: ...Ah, you're not here about the Shogun Statues? Sorry, we've just gotten so many queries concerning those recently.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Hmm? You're talking to me... Are you a customer?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's this shop all about?

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: We mainly sell souvenirs, like Inazuman novels, tanuki dolls, and stuff like that.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Back then... we might have also sold statues of the Almighty Shogun and other related goods as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Sadly, we haven't really seen that many customers since the lockdown came into effect except for those Snezhnayan merchants who want to entertain their families.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: *sigh* So you're not here to buy anything after all, are you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kinds of dolls?

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Our featured products are statues of fox spirits and porcelain tanuki dolls. Uh... tanuki dolls sell a bit better.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: They represent good fortune in Inazuma. Many business owners buy one to place in their stores, hoping for financial success.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: They look really cute as well! It's not a bad idea to gift them to your favorite girl or the children in your family.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Statues of the Shogun?

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Yeah, our Almighty Shogun is a merciful and forgiving person who doesn't really mind people buying the statues for any reason whatsoever.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: *sigh* It used to be our best-selling product...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Sadly, we've lost our customer base ever since the lockdown happened. And such a delicate item is not cheap to craft, so we've had no choice but to take them off the shelves.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Again, seriously— uh, I mean, hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what do you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: We mainly sell souvenirs, like Inazuman novels, tanuki dolls, and stuff like that.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: During special periods like holidays or festivals, we would also sell statues of the Almighty Shogun and other related goods.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Statues of the Shogun?

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Yeah, our Almighty Shogun is a merciful and forgiving person who doesn't really mind people buying the statues for any reason whatsoever.

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Before the Sakoku Decree was instated, it was our best-selling product... But the old edition has long ceased production, and we've switched to a new one since.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Ack... How? I can't believe I lost because of this...

dialogues.speaker: Kaede
dialogues.text: Ah, why don't you buy a doll? Maybe it'll give you better luck...
